title: Grusch gave Congress locations of spacecraft, no subpoenas followed
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Grusch gave Congress locations of spacecraft, no subpoenas followed, about 2023-2025 at Washington, D.C., and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: David gave them first hand direct information from his sources of where to look, where to find the spacecraft.

plain: A journalist named Ross Coulthart says that David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who went public as a whistleblower in 2023, gave the US Congress firsthand information from his sources about exactly where to look for recovered spacecraft. According to Coulthart, Congress was told where to find them, yet no subpoenas, the legal orders that force people to hand over evidence, followed through 2025. If true, it would mean lawmakers had a map to the evidence and did not use it.
